audio._note: Empty ffmpeg = vendor/ffmpeg/ffmpeg.exe if present, else PATH. The ffmpeg capture backend is only chosen when audio.input names a device; otherwise Windows MCI records from the default device.

tts._note: engine: sapi (Windows voices, cannot read Persian) | cmd (Piper, eSpeak-NG) | aval (Aval.ai voices — the route measured on real Persian speech in bench/voice/VOICE-RESULTS.md)

stt._note: engine: aval (Aval transcription models) | cmd (local whisper.cpp through the command below). Leave stt.command empty when using aval.

aval._api_key_note: Leave empty to reuse the Aval key already configured for the agent (AVAL_API_KEY, or the avalai provider in the OpenCode config). The key is never logged and is redacted from API error text.
aval._format_note: ElevenLabs through Aval serves mp3 only (wav/pcm answer HTTP 503), and the bridge decodes it with the ffmpeg below before playback. A tool-free alternative measured in the same bench: tts_model=gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts, tts_voice=Kore, tts_format=wav.
aval.stt_prompt: دفتر مدرسه، ولی دانش‌آموز، غیبت، اجازه خروج، شماره تماس
aval._budget_note: Cloud voice is billed per turn. Once a call has spent this, phone_say and phone_listen return voice-budget-exceeded instead of running up a bill. $0.15 ≈ two minutes on the pinned pair (eleven_v4_turbo $0.0007/s + scribe_v2 $0.000062/s).
